expected_parent_change: Reuse stops being a recorded plan and becomes a re-decided action: on 212 real two-step compositions in 48 files the operation stayed legal after the change in 212 of 212 pairs, while the recorded plan was stale in 109 (51.4%) and silently corrupt in 59 (27.8%), and all 103 correct replays had zero drift between proof and replay.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The permanent object is the method (decision procedure + premise + cost) and the verifier, never the plan: a learned action may veto but never license, every application re-proves its premise on the live state and re-reads the result against the sentence it claims, and composition re-checks the second premise against the first step's effect instead of against the record.

falsification_condition: Any replay accepted without a postcondition check; any silent corruption counted as a match; any zero-drift case presented as safe without the four measured counterexamples; any claim that zero drift is sufficient; any capability, benchmark or terminal credit; any run reported without its corpus fingerprint.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. The barrier to a coding floor is no longer candidate generation but the premise: a plan is valid on one state, so reuse must be a re-decision, and the measurement says how much of what the tree called reuse was a plan applied to a state it was never proved on.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The plan saves search but never carries authority; the postcondition check costs one parse and one name scan per application and removes the 59 silent corruptions by construction.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The same protocol applies to any state, including a GUI window: re-observe, re-prove the premise, act, re-read.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Plain replay is wrong 51.4% of the time and silently wrong 27.8%; a fingerprint alone still admits the 4 zero-drift stale cases; one plan per state is unbounded and still unproved; a model is prohibited producer cognition.

route_frontier.negative_search_summary: Three routes were refused on this tree's own measurement: plain replay (51.4% of 212 real compositions stale, 27.8% silently corrupt), fingerprint-only invalidation (necessary, but 4 stale replays had zero drift), and one stored plan per state (unbounded, and every plan is still unproved on the next state). A model-based repair was refused as producer cognition.
